QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566`) carves allocations out of a caller-supplied buffer. It calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` to point the hooks at its own functions. With `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`, those are mutex-wrapped variants (`buffer_alloc_calloc_mutexed` / `buffer_alloc_free_mutexed`, lines 541-563)."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the init installs mutex-wrapped variants under MBEDTLS_THREADING_C, but it never states the plain pair used otherwise, nor that the choice is made at compile time inside the init function.
